scripts.build:worker: esbuild packages/worker/src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/worker/index.js && cd dist/worker && rm -f ../worker.zip && zip -q ../worker.zip index.js && echo built dist/worker.zip
scripts.build:gateway: esbuild packages/gateway/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/gateway.mjs && echo built dist/gateway.mjs
scripts.build:api: esbuild packages/api/src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/api/index.js && cd dist/api && rm -f ../api.zip && zip -q ../api.zip index.js && echo built dist/api.zip
